claim_text: Dosage analysis plus DNA sequencing detects a pathogenic NF1 variant in about 90% of classic nonfounder NF1 patients, and adding RNA-based sequencing raises detection to 95-97%.
notes: Full text (PMC8354850). Data cited from a primary study (secondary citation in a consensus paper): ref 34.
